#1
धर्मक्षेत्रे|dharma-kṣetre|dharma — sacred duty, the right order (here: 'of dharma', first member of the compound);;kṣetra — field (loc. sg. kṣetre: 'on the field')
कुरुक्षेत्रे|kuru-kṣetre|Kuru — the Kuru clan, ancestors of both sides;;kṣetra — field (loc. sg.: 'on the field of the Kurus')
समवेता|samavetāḥ|samavetā — assembled, gathered (past participle of sam-ava-i; nom. pl. masc.; final -ḥ dropped before the following y-)
युयुत्सवः|yuyutsavaḥ|yuyutsu — wanting to fight (desiderative adjective from yudh 'fight'; nom. pl. masc.)
--
मामकाः|māmakāḥ|māmaka — mine, my people (nom. pl. masc.)
पाण्डवाश्चैव|pāṇḍavāḥ ca eva|pāṇḍava — son of Pāṇḍu, a Pāṇḍava (nom. pl.; -āḥ + c- becomes -āś c-);;ca — and;;eva — indeed, just (ca + eva fuse to caiva)
किमकुर्वत|kim akurvata|kim — what?;;kṛ — to do (akurvata: imperfect middle, 3rd pl. 'they did')
संजय|saṃjaya|Saṃjaya — Sañjaya, the blind king's minister and narrator (vocative)
#2
